Sindhi College, under the aegis of the Sindhi Educational Society (Madras), launched the renovated state-of-the-art auditorium and modernised administrative block.
According to a press release, the college has undertaken extensive infrastructure development and improvement work. The initiative reflects the institution’s commitment to providing modern facilities, strengthening environmental responsibility and creating a more vibrant, sustainable and welcoming campus.
The ceremony was held in the presence of Justice K. Kannan, former Judge of the Madras High Court and Punjab and Haryana High Court; Rajalal Nichani, Chairman; J.C. Prakash, Secretary; Dushyant Mehra, Treasurer; and Rajesh Khanna, Member of the Sindhi Educational Society (Madras), the release said.
